name: style_tile
purpose: Defines the film's look: a small corner of the apartment as a paper diorama in the palette. Every later asset references it (doc 08, generation order 1).
target: largest landscape size available, 6 separate pieces (wall, desk edge, calendar, lamp, laptop, gator)

name: gator_sheet
purpose: The Student, the film's hero gator: a turnaround plus separated cutout parts that drop straight onto the side rig in src/characters/gator.js. Gate G2. Carries G1's approved design (style tile v3_4, the graphic picture-book gator) and Q9 (short stubby legs).
shots: s02-s12, s14-s18 (close-ups in s06, s15, s18 H)
target: largest landscape size available, one sheet with nothing else on it: 4 turnaround pieces (top row) and 10 rig parts (middle and bottom rows), one shared scale, every bounding box >= 40 px from every other and from the frame edge (prompt asks 60)

turn_side.face: painted: eye, smile line, tooth tips, nostril dot
turn_side.orientation: full figure facing +x, standing, arms down, legs ~20% of standing height

turn_front.face: blank: eyes and mouth are face_sheet swaps
turn_front.orientation: full figure facing camera, painted without arms (the rig adds arm_l/arm_r); snout foreshortened as a broad rounded muzzle with two nostril bumps and tooth tips at the jaw line; no cream face or throat patch

turn_back.orientation: full figure from behind, arms down, tail toward camera

turn_head34.rig: side rig head34, pivot [0.4, 0.75], swaps head+snout+jaw (s14)
turn_head34.face: both eyes painted, partly visible (v2 brief: "both eyes partly visible"); no mouth beyond the jaw seam and tooth tips
turn_head34.orientation: head and snout turned about 45 degrees toward +x, snout angling away into depth

body.orientation: hoodie torso facing +x, hood rolled down at the back of the neck, green hips below the hem; no head, arms, legs, tail or pocket

head.face: blank: eyes and mouth are face_sheet swaps
head.orientation: cranium facing +x with the semicircle eye bump on top, no snout, no jaw

snout.orientation: pointing +x, root left, blunt rounded tip right, one tiny nostril dot near the tip

jaw.orientation: pointing +x, root left; cream underside; 3-4 tiny cream triangle tooth tips along its top edge

arm_l.orientation: horizontal, shoulder end left, rounded green mitten hand right

arm_r.orientation: horizontal, shoulder end left, rounded green mitten hand right

leg_l.orientation: vertical, hip end up and cut flat (no lighter cylinder top), foot pointing +x; short and stubby

leg_r.orientation: vertical, hip end up and cut flat (no lighter cylinder top), foot pointing +x; short and stubby

tail.orientation: pointing -x, root right; cream underside, darker green rounded scallops along the top edge

pocket.orientation: cream hoodie kangaroo pocket, a soft rounded rectangle

proportions: legs about 20% of standing height, as in v3_4 (the rig's legs are 37%; the sheet sets the truth and the rig is refit to it)
acceptance: keeps v3_4's design: flat geometric shapes, strong simple silhouette, blunt long snout with a few tiny cream triangle tooth tips, semicircle eye bump, scalloped tail, cream hoodie, stubby legs, friendly read
torn paper, not felt: flat colour, a visible pale torn fibre rim of 2-6 px on every piece (as the style tile wall and desk), fine paper grain, no fuzz or pile
no baked-in light or shadow; background alpha or flat magenta
every bounding box >= 40 px from every other piece and from the frame edge, measured
no text or artifacts; on palette (gator green, cream, a black pupil on turn_side only)
head and turn_front painted without eye or mouth; turn_head34 shows both eyes partly; turn_side fully featured
cut.mjs --auto gives one island per piece (14)
turn_front reads as a gator: broad foreshortened muzzle, two nostril bumps, tooth tips at the jaw line, no cream mask
turn_head34 is a real 3/4 head (about 45 degrees, snout angling away)
keeps v1_1 side view, colours and proportions exactly
leg tops cut flat
refs_note: v2: v1_1 is the approved base (G2 round 1, director: "sounds good ok we can continue"); doc 08 lets an approved pick be a reference for its own revision. It lives only in assets/raw/ (gitignored), so gen.mjs refuses where it is missing.

name: gator_hero
purpose: The Student, large, for the close-ups in s06, s15 and s18 H: the side view of gator_sheet (v1_1 base) repainted alone at the largest size (doc 08: one piece per image for frame-filling use). Same pose and design as the sheet side view, fully featured face.
refs_note: v1_1 is the approved gator_sheet base (G2 round 1); it lives only in assets/raw/ (gitignored).
target: largest landscape size available, one full side-view figure alone, figure height >= 70% of the canvas height (prompt asks ~85%), >= 40 px margin to every frame edge

hero_side.rig: whole-figure close-up piece (no face slots), same as gator_sheet turn_side
hero_side.face: painted: eye, smile line, tooth tips, nostril dot
hero_side.orientation: full figure facing +x, standing, arms down, legs ~20% of standing height

acceptance: same pose and design as gator_sheet v1_1 turn_side
figure height >= 70% of the canvas height, measured
torn paper: visible pale torn fibre rim on every cut edge, no fuzz or pile
no baked-in light or shadow; background alpha or flat magenta
nothing touching the frame edge; no text or artifacts; on palette
cut.mjs --auto gives one island

name: face_sheet
purpose: Every eye and mouth swap from doc 03 Face set, at one size and line weight, so the swaps drop onto the frozen gator head (gator_sheet v2_1) with no in-betweens. Shared, scaled, by the roommates and the Freshman; must read from above in s13.
target: landscape at the frozen gator_sheet pixel scale (1672 x 941): open eye disc 59 px (measured on gator_sheet turn_side: 59 x 60 px at centre (298.5, 130), pupil 37 x 38 px at (309.5, 131)); 11 pieces in three rows, >= 80 px apart

eyes_open.rig: eyes slot, take open (side rig head, at [0.010, 0.010])
eyes_open.face: cream disc 59 px, pupil 37 px toward +x, one highlight dot

eyes_closed.rig: eyes slot, take closed (side rig head, at [0.010, 0.010])
eyes_closed.face: content: a dark green upward arc, no disc

eyes_tired.rig: eyes slot, take tired (side rig head, at [0.010, 0.010])
eyes_tired.face: open eye with a green lid over the top half

eyes_gasp.rig: eyes slot, take gasp (side rig head, at [0.010, 0.010])

eyes_worried.rig: eyes slot, take worried (side rig head, at [0.010, 0.010])
eyes_worried.face: pupil down and back, slanted lid sliver, two cream sweat drops touching the disc

eyes_side.rig: eyes slot, take side (side rig head, at [0.010, 0.010])

eyes_front_open.rig: not consumed yet: the front rig (facing front) shares the side eyes slot; needs a char-rigs change
eyes_front_open.face: two 59 px discs ~95 px apart, pupils centred, looking at camera

mouth_neutral.rig: mouth slot, take neutral (side rig head, at [0.022, -0.002])
mouth_neutral.face: near-straight dark green line ~60 px, 7 px thick

mouth_smile.face: the frozen smile line, ~70 px, curving up toward +x

mouth_o.face: dark green oval ~22 px, slightly taller than wide

acceptance: 10 pieces (6 side eyes, 4 mouths) plus the front open pair
open eye disc within 5% of the frozen head eye (59.5 px), measured
every piece at the same line weight and scale (one stroke thickness, one disc size except gasp)
keeps the approved look: one big round eye, small highlight, simple smile line, friendly read
no baked-in light or shadow; background alpha or flat magenta
parts not touching; no text or artifacts; on palette (cream, black pupils, gator green lids, one dark green line colour)
cut.mjs --auto islands accounted for against pieces
